name: Synagogue
overview: The synagogue served as a central gathering place for Jews and God-fearers where the Scriptures were read and expounded, as seen in Nehemiah 8 and 9. Jesus actively taught, preached, and healed in synagogues throughout Galilee and other cities, demonstrating their role as important venues for both worship and ministry (Matthew 4:23; 9:35). Additionally, synagogues were places where acts of charity were practiced, though Jesus warned against doing such deeds for public recognition (Matthew 6:2).
